title: Merkleized TLS Proxies
tagline: Compare verification latency tradeoffs of three integrity-check strategies across varying session sizes.

curves.label: Full Transcript Hash
curves.code: for (let i=0;i<n;i++){ h = hash32(h, transcript[i]); } return finalize(h);
curves.name: Full Transcript Hash

curves.label: Merkle Root Batch Proof
curves.code: leafHashes = transcript.map(chunk=>hash32(chunk)); root = merkleReduce(leafHashes); proof = buildProof(root, targetIndex); return verifyProof(proof);
curves.name: Merkle Root Batch Proof

curves.label: Path-Focused Rehash
curves.code: index = targetIndex; recompute = hash32(transcript[index]); while(index>0){ sibling = getSibling(index); recompute = hashPair(recompute, sibling); index = Math.floor((index-1)/2); } return verifyRecomputedRoot(recompute);
curves.name: Path-Focused Rehash

curves.label: Naive Per-Chunk Signature Checks
curves.code: for (let i=0;i<n;i++){ ok = verifySignature(signature[i], transcript[i]); if(!ok) return false; } return true;
curves.name: Naive Per-Chunk Signature Checks
